players.product: overlay metrology systems (front-end and bump/TSV packaging overlay) and wafer-warpage inspection for DRAM / NAND / HBM

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue down about 40.9% from the prior-year half, with an operating loss; Q2 2026 revenue KRW 11,366,242,002 (Q2 2025: KRW 13,867,760,103) and Q2 operating loss KRW 2,294,089,349 (Q2 2025 loss: KRW 662,363,809)

H1 2026 product mix: 12-inch overlay metrology systems (OL-12inch) KRW 8,400M (46.21%, all domestic), other products KRW 5,200M (28.60%), merchandise KRW 813M (4.47%), services KRW 3,766M (20.72%); overlay's share fell from 70.37% in FY2025. Exports only KRW 1,632M vs domestic KRW 16,547M. The company says it and a US company ('K') are the only two participants in the image-based overlay market; K holds 60-65%+ of the overlay market and a Dutch lithography maker ('A') the rest
quarterly_data.figure: OL-12inch KRW 8,400M (46.21%); services KRW 3,766M (20.72%); exports KRW 1,632M of KRW 18,179M

quarterly_data.signal: Overlay metrology production: capacity 24 units in H1 2026, 5 units produced, utilisation 20.8% (FY2025: 20 of 30, 66.7%; FY2024: 25 of 30, 83.3%)

Customer concentration (customers not named in the filing): Customer A KRW 10,914,015,523 of H1 2026 revenue (Q2: KRW 8,108,021,523) and Customer B KRW 5,623,249,689 (Q2: KRW 2,835,477,680); Customers C and D, above 10% in H1 2025, had no H1 2026 sales
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A KRW 10,914,015,523; Customer B KRW 5,623,249,689 of H1 revenue KRW 18,178,928,229

quarterly_data.signal: No order-backlog table (purchase orders normally arrive 1-2 months before delivery); contract liabilities (customer advances) rose to KRW 5,349,844,800 at June 30, 2026 from KRW 264,844,800 at end-2025 (KRW 7,425,000,000 added in H1); finished-goods inventory rose to KRW 12,894M from KRW 5,634M

R&D plan: next-generation overlay metrology system (high-end overlay performance, 192-layer-plus V-NAND solution, 2x throughput, real-cell matching) and a new Thin Film Metrology business (wafer film-thickness metrology), which the company estimates at about twice the overlay metrology market and expects to be a mid- to long-term growth driver; back-end MI equipment under development. H1 R&D spend KRW 8,143M, 44.26% of revenue

Capex and footprint: H1 2026 PP&E acquisitions KRW 6,939,442,784, construction in progress KRW 12,368,707,850 at period end; headquarters moved in March 2026 (new building leased from affiliate CM Technology, right-of-use assets up to KRW 20,926M); US subsidiary AUROS Technology USA liquidated in June 2026
quarterly_data.figure: PP&E acquisitions KRW 6,939,442,784; construction in progress KRW 12,368,707,850
